subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should this remain the distinct owner for Telegram `/reasoning stream` plus Control UI history pressure, or should maintainers fold it into the broader ambiguous Telegram delivery recovery track?
rationale: The source evidence supports a shared ambiguous-send recovery gap, but this report adds a reasoning-stream trigger and Control UI history pressure that the broader Telegram lane issue and open mitigation PR do not fully own.

options.title: Keep Distinct Reasoning/History Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the place to prove and fix `/reasoning stream` preview/final delivery and decide whether `chat.history` needs debouncing or backpressure.

options.title: Fold Into Telegram Recovery
options.body: Treat the reasoning and history details as symptoms and track remaining Telegram unknown-send recovery through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456 and related recovery PRs.

options.title: Split UI History Separately
options.body: Use this issue for Telegram ambiguous-send recovery and create or select a separate Control UI item for the `chat.history` latency burst.

recommendation.title: Keep Distinct Reasoning/History Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the place to prove and fix `/reasoning stream` preview/final delivery and decide whether `chat.history` needs debouncing or backpressure.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame spans the shared recovery guard, Telegram adapter capability surface, draft stream ambiguity, and Control UI history reload path, though the broad commit makes this a routing hint rather than ownership proof.
